claims.statement: Runnable documentation examples are authored in supported-language files under `src/code-samples/`; `src/code-samples-generated/` is a gitignored extraction intermediate and snippet MDX is generated from the source rather than hand-authored.

The extractor is line based and recognizes language-specific `:snippet-start:`/`:snippet-end:` and `:remove-start:`/`:remove-end:` comment markers, strips remove regions, dedents snippet bodies, and fails on unclosed snippet or remove markers.

The sample runner accepts an explicit supported file list or recursively selects eligible samples, executes Python, TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Go, and shell through their language toolchains, and defaults each invocation timeout to 1,200 seconds.

`make code-snippets` runs extraction followed by MDX generation; a full extraction clears supported intermediates and rebuilds them, while `CODE_SNIPPET_SOURCES` replaces intermediates only for selected valid source stems but MDX generation still scans all existing intermediates.

MDX generation emits language fences, consumes optional code-group presentation markers, and expands the first eligible Python or TypeScript model ID and repeated matching occurrences into seven-provider CodeGroups; `KEEP MODEL`, embedding IDs, and models passed to embeddings or provider-specific chat constructors remain unexpanded so the resulting sample stays runnable, and a trace CTA is appended only when the manifest supplies a URL.

The Test Code Samples workflow skips fork PR sample execution, tests changed eligible sample files on internal PRs and all samples on manual or monthly runs, and enables tracing only for manual or scheduled full runs.

Public trace sharing is an explicit publication operation: `make update-code-sample-traces` enables tracing, uses the configured or default `docs-code-samples` project, runs samples, then regenerates MDX; it requires `LANGSMITH_API_KEY`.

With tracing enabled, successful sample runs are processed under a lock for trace collection so parallel workers cannot overwrite the shared manifest or claim the same LangSmith run; collection matches a root run stamped with the source's sole snippet ID rather than falling back to a nearby run.
Trace collection records multi-snippet sources as skipped and removes any stale per-snippet entries; only a source with exactly one marker can receive a public share URL and manifest entry.

The runner defaults to four workers and serializes only `evaluate-rag-` and `experiment-runs-query-` path families with per-group locks, so samples sharing those LangSmith fixtures cannot overlap while unrelated samples remain concurrent.

LangSmith rate limits are retried up to five total attempts by default with a linear 30-second base delay capped at 120 seconds; both settings are environment-configurable, and an exhausted rate-limited sample is skipped rather than failed.

With tracing enabled, trace collection runs only after a successful sample under a lock, retries 429 errors with the runner policy, and records collection exceptions as warnings without failing the runner.
The sample workflow ultimately fails when ordinary samples failed, while a separate observer creates a Linear issue only for failed or cancelled scheduled sample runs.

If a successful single-snippet sample has no root run stamped with its snippet ID, trace collection removes any existing manifest entry so later MDX regeneration removes the stale public-trace CTA rather than linking an unverified run.
The code-sample CI job provisions PostgreSQL plus Python, Node, Java/JBang, and Go, with a 60-minute timeout for pull requests and a 150-minute timeout for scheduled or manually dispatched full runs.

On manual or scheduled OSS runs, CI regenerates snippets only when the sample test was not cancelled, fewer than 20 samples failed, and at least one trace link was updated; after successful regeneration it updates or creates the deterministic `chore/refresh-code-sample-traces` pull request only when the trace manifest or generated snippet MDX differs.

The async-subagent TypeScript sample obtains the subagent thread from its task ID, reads its pending interrupt, and creates a resumed run whose command maps that interrupt ID to the app-provided answer; the async-subagents guide imports its generated MDX fragment.

The OpenAI observability quickstart sample wraps an OpenAI client and decorates both its context helper and assistant pipeline with LangSmith tracing; its `KEEP MODEL` marker is removed during MDX generation while preserving the provider-specific model call, and the tracing quickstart imports the generated Python fragment.

The CI workflow separates code samples into independent OSS and LangSmith matrix legs, checks that every top-level product directory is covered, and enables trace collection only for manual or scheduled OSS legs.

The scheduled-run Linear observer warns rather than failing when `LINEAR_TEAM_KEY` is unset; otherwise it creates separate OSS and LangSmith tickets for unsuccessful matrix legs and a generic ticket when no leg ran.
